mentions.name: Charlastar
mentions.description: An AI study buddy that acts as a peer-level "study friend" students can work alongside, ask questions, and stay on track with. It packages AI help into something high-schoolers actually want to use while studying, and is free to try with no login or credit card required. Built with Claude Code, TypeScript, and React, hosted on Cloudflare Pages for the frontend with Workers for the API, and used as a weekly family project to learn product thinking, design, pricing, and marketing.
mentions.problem: AI chatbots aren't packaged in a way high-schoolers actually want to use when studying; students need a peer-level companion to work alongside and stay on track with.
mentions.audience: High school students studying, who want a peer-level study friend to keep them on track
mentions.source_excerpt: My twins (in high school) and I are building an AI study buddy.The idea is simple. A peer-level “study friend” you can work alongside, ask questions, and stay on track with.
